description: Extract the register map: memory addresses, reset values, access permissions (RO/RW/W1C), and per-bit field definitions. canonical_output.value_checks labels each value by the check that reached it: verified means an outside source (OCR of the printed page, the vendor's register file) agreed; flagged values list both readings. No label claims a value is true of the chip. Runs DatasheetVend Fast Extraction: a page scout routes targeted model reads and the module's own deterministic readers, then the same normalization and completion checks as a dashboard job finish the result, usually in seconds; `engine` names the engine on every result. If Fast Extraction cannot complete the module, the slower deep engine re-runs that module alone (engine.runtime is then `monolith_rescue`; the result says so, and it is billed as delivered). A rescue can take several minutes, so set a client timeout of 10 minutes. Only if the deep engine also cannot deliver does the module return status FAILED with the reason.

documentPath.description: https:// URL to the datasheet PDF. The remote /api/mcp endpoint accepts ONLY https:// URLs (it downloads them); a local filesystem path works solely in local stdio mode (npm run mcp:serve).

partName.description: Optional part number / MPN to disambiguate a multi-part datasheet.

name: datasheetvend_extract_register_map

canonical_output.description: The module's canonical (CAD-ready normalized) output block.

duration_ms.description: Wall time of the extraction in milliseconds

failed_modules.description: Modules that came back without a result: Fast Extraction could not extract them, and neither could the per-module deep-engine rescue where one was attempted

lanes.description: How each module was answered, where the engine recorded it

lane.description: deterministic_primary, worker_with_deterministic_brain, deterministic_recovery, worker_only, or monolith_rescue

name.description: The engine the extraction started on: always "fast_extraction" (runtime says what answered)

runtime.description: The runtime that answered: the Fast Extraction runtime, or "monolith_rescue" when the deep engine re-ran this module; null when no engine could run

engineering_summary.description: Concise human-readable engineering summary, when emitted.

extracted_data.description: The module's extraction after its own normalization — values with the datasheet page they came from (source_page, where one was recorded) and, where the module provides them, confidence_score and source_text_snippet.

reasons.description: Why review is required, if it is

required.description: Whether a human should verify before trusting this wholesale

status.description: The module's completion status (for example approved, approved_with_warnings or empty), or FAILED when Fast Extraction could not extract the module

warnings.description: Public engineering warnings from the extraction.

title: Extract hardware register map
